scenarios.title: Payment gateway outage and incident response
messages: Alert: Stripe payment gateway is returning 503 errors for 12% of checkout attempts since 14:30 UTC. Ahmed is leading the incident response.
Rollback attempted on the Stripe API client from v3.2 to v3.1. Error rate dropped from 12% to 3% but did not fully resolve.
Decision: failover checkout traffic to Adyen while Stripe investigates. Ahmed authorized the switch at 14:47 UTC.
Customer impact: approximately 840 transactions failed during the 47-minute outage. Refunds being processed automatically.
Postmortem: root cause was a certificate chain error in Stripe v3.2. The intermediate CA expired but the client did not validate the chain.
Action item: Ahmed to implement synthetic transaction monitoring for Stripe and Adyen by Friday. Severity: P1.

Decision: failover checkout traffic to Adyen while Stripe investigates. Miguel authorized the switch at 14:47 UTC.
Customer impact: approximately 840 transactions failed during the 47-minute outage. Refunds being processed automatically.
Postmortem: root cause was a certificate chain error in Stripe v3.2. The intermediate CA expired but the client did not validate the chain.
Action item: Miguel to implement synthetic transaction monitoring for Stripe and Adyen by Biyernes. Severity: P1.

scenarios.title: Supplier quality dispute and credit note negotiation
messages: The supplier PhilPack delivered lot LOT-4408 on 6/5. Quality control found printing defect: print measured at 12% defective versus the spec limit of 3%.
We issued a credit note request of PHP 12,600 to PhilPack for the non-conforming LOT-4408. PhilPack disputes the claim and says goods were conforming at dispatch.
The invoice FA-2025-0411 for PHP 90,000 is overdue by 15 days days. Payment is blocked pending resolution of the credit note dispute.
Production confirms: the 2,000 boxes affected units in quarantine are unusable. We purchased from an alternate supplier at a surcharge of PHP 3,200.
PhilPack proposed a commercial gesture of PHP 6,000 instead of the full PHP 12,600. Decision needed from Andrea.
Decision: Andrea accepts the reduced credit of PHP 6,000 and releases payment of invoice FA-2025-0411, deducting the credit. Condition: PhilPack provides a QA report for the next shipment.

scenarios.title: Database migration from MySQL to Postgres
messages: Decision: migrate the billing database from MySQL to Postgres next sprint. Owner is Somchai. Risk: service downtime during cutover.
